title: Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents
title_zh: 小而强大：测试套件作为自我进化智能体的改进信号

paragraphs.en: Self-Evolving Diversity-Driven Search for Robust AI Systems
paragraphs.zh: 由多样性驱动的自演化搜索：构建鲁棒的智能体系统

paragraphs.en: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass. Verifying a rewrite by agent rollout is expensive and subjective, while executable checks such as the repository’s own tests are too sparse to catch behavior-changing rewrites, rejecting only a quarter of them. We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality–diversity evolutionary algorithm, so that the signal is dense and informative. tesearch treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so that quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable, and learns a transition kernel during the search that denoises the LLM as an actuator on that descriptor. Across 129 129 real-world modules and three backbones, tesearch delivers the highest-quality suites of any method compared, LLM-driven evolutionary search included, and the smallest of any LLM-based one. Used as the improvement signal of a self-evolving agent, it rejects 59.9 % 59.9\% of behavior-changing rewrites against 25.3 % 25.3\% for the repository’s tests, at a 4.0 % 4.0\% false-alarm rate and 3.5 3.5 s per decision. The code and data are available at https://github.com/ccsnow127/TeSearch .

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents get stronger by editing the code that runs them: the harness that prompts the model, parses its actions, executes them and records the trajectory [ 34 , 55 , 67 ] . The check a rewrite must pass to be kept is the agent’s improvement signal . Accept a rewrite that silently changes behavior and every later episode and rewrite inherits it; reject rewrites that preserve behavior and the evolution stalls. In software engineering the executable form of this check is the test suite, a regression specification [ 62 ] that captures the accepted behavior of the code so that later modification can preserve it.
paragraphs.zh: 自我演化的智能体通过编辑运行它们的代码来增强自身能力：这种机制负责提示模型、解析其行动、执行这些行动并记录轨迹 [ 34 , 55 , 67 ] 。 重写必须通过的一项检验是智能体的改进信号。 接受那些悄无声息改变行为的重写，之后每一轮迭代和重写都会继承这种变化；而拒绝那些保持原有行为的重写，则会导致演化停滞。 在软件工程领域，这项检验的可执行形式是测试套件，即一种回归规范 [ 62 ]，它捕捉了代码的既定行为，以便后续修改时能够保留这些行为。

paragraphs.en: The signals available today are weak. Accepting on rollout outcome spends an agent episode per candidate on a noisy end-to-end score. The repository’s own tests are free, but they were written before the agent existed and anticipate none of its edits: we find them rejecting only 25.3 % 25.3\% of the rewrites that change behavior ( Section 5.3 ). A generated suite can do better, but only if it is effective , so that a behavioral change breaks at least one test, and efficient , since it runs on every proposed rewrite and its failures are read by a model with a finite context. Existing generators, search-based or LLM-based, optimize effectiveness and leave size to whatever emerges [ 18 , 35 , 2 , 24 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 目前可用的信号很弱。 根据部署结果进行接受，会为每个候选智能体消耗一个智能体回合，并基于一个充满噪声的端到端得分做出判断。 该存储库自身的测试是免费的，但这些测试是在智能体出现之前编写的，并未预料到任何由智能体带来的修改：我们发现这些测试仅拒绝了 25.3%（25.3\%）会改变行为的改写版本（第 5.3 节）。 生成的测试套件表现可能更好，但前提是它必须有效，即行为变化至少会破坏一个测试；同时它也必须高效，因为它会在每个提议的改写版本上运行，而测试失败的结果会被一个上下文有限的模型读取。 现有的生成器，无论是基于搜索的还是基于大语言模型的，都专注于优化有效性，而将规模问题留给最终生成的结果 [18, 35, 2, 24]。

paragraphs.en: We formulate size-optimized unit test generation and, rather than scalarizing quality against size, let size define where a suite competes and quality whether it wins : size is a behavior descriptor of a quality–diversity (QD) search [ 39 , 45 ] , so the small end stays alive instead of being eliminated by the large one. Two challenges follow. LLM calls are expensive, so a finite budget must be allocated across niches whose value is unknown. And unlike classical QD, the descriptor cannot be set directly: the search can only ask the LLM for a count, which LLMs follow imprecisely [ 71 ] , so the niche a call targets and the niche it lands in differ.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将单元测试生成问题转化为规模优化问题，并且，而不是将质量与规模进行标量化比较，我们让规模来决定测试套件在何处竞争，而质量则决定其能否胜出：规模是质量–多样性（QD）搜索中的一个行为描述符 [39, 45]，因此规模较小的部分得以保留，而非被规模较大的部分淘汰。由此带来了两个挑战。 LLM 调用成本高昂，因此必须在价值未知的不同领域之间分配有限的预算。 而且与经典的 QD 方法不同，该描述符无法直接设定：搜索过程只能向 LLM 请求一个计数值，而 LLM 提供的结果并不精确 [71]，因此调用所针对的领域与实际落入的领域存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents and improvement signals. Self-improving LLM systems differ first in where an improvement is written. Weight-space methods fine-tune the model on its own data or rewards [ 56 , 74 , 73 ] , a gain that cannot be read, diffed or reverted. Context-space methods write into the harness instead, through verbal self-refinement [ 37 , 49 ] , prompt search and textual gradients [ 60 , 64 , 44 , 1 ] , experience memory [ 68 ] , skill synthesis [ 54 ] or search over the whole scaffold [ 22 ] ; at the frontier the agent rewrites its own code, including the procedure that performs the update [ 17 , 65 , 67 , 34 ] . What decides whether an improvement is kept ranges from the model’s own judgment [ 6 , 63 ] to external verifiers such as tests [ 7 , 9 ] , compilers [ 29 , 20 ] and environments [ 36 ] . Tests are the signal coding agents such as Cursor, Codex and Claude Code [ 4 , 42 , 3 ] lean on across whole repositories [ 26 , 61 , 66 ] , yet they are taken as given: the repository’s own or written ad hoc. We optimize the test signal itself, for the strength and cost a loop running it on every rewrite needs. See Appendix F for additional related work.

paragraphs.en: Evolutionary and quality–diversity search. LLMs used as variation operators under executable fitness make evolutionary search a strong inference-time optimizer [ 47 , 41 , 28 ] , but a global objective concentrates the population around one mode [ 19 , 16 ] . QD optimization instead partitions the search space by behavior descriptors and optimizes quality within each region [ 30 , 15 ] : MAP-Elites keeps an elite per cell [ 39 ] , and MOME a Pareto front per cell whose hypervolumes it sums [ 45 ] . Search-based test generation evolves program inputs against coverage goals [ 18 , 35 ] and test-suite reduction shrinks a written suite post hoc [ 21 , 48 ] ; neither controls size during generation. In classical QD the descriptor is read off what an individual turns out to be; here it must be requested from an LLM before it can be observed, and tesearch models that actuation error explicitly.

paragraphs.en: We use the 129 129 distinct Python modules of TestGenEval [ 24 ] , each with a containerized harness. paragraphs.en: Results. tesearch rejects 59.9 % 59.9\% of divergent revisions against 25.3 % 25.3\% for the repository tests, and more on every module ( Table 2 ). Repository tests check that a module performs its function; a mutation-optimized suite also pins the details a mutant perturbs, such as a separator, a default or which exception surfaces, so the gap is widest on modules that parse model outputs or render what the model reads. The tighter constraint costs little: tesearch rejects 10 10 of the 253 253 equivalent revisions, a 4.0 % 4.0\% false-alarm rate, where the repository tests reject none. A decision takes 3.5 3.5 s against 5.9 5.9 s and calls no model, where acceptance by rollout spends an agent episode: the agent can afford this signal on every rewrite it proposes.

paragraphs.en: Self-evolving agents now rewrite their own harness fluently; what they cannot yet tell is whether a self-referential edit is correct and leaves existing behavior intact. This paper targets that gap with a quality–diversity evolutionary search that treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable, and learns a transition kernel during the search that denoises the LLM as an actuator on that descriptor. Across 129 129 modules and three backbones the resulting suites are the strongest of any method compared and the smallest of any LLM-based one, and as the gate of a self-evolving agent they reject 59.9 % 59.9\% of behavior-changing rewrites against 25.3 % 25.3\% for the repository’s tests, at 3.5 3.5 s per decision and no model call. tesearch is thus an effective improvement signal for self-evolving agents: strong enough to catch what a rewrite silently broke, cheap enough to run on every rewrite.

paragraphs.en: Parents are selected by size proximity from the two sides of the target: the Pareto-front suite nearest τ k ∗ \tau_{k^{\ast}} in log size among those smaller than the target, and the nearest among those larger. Because the grid is geometric, the niche index is log size up to a constant, so each side is a one-dimensional nearest-neighbor lookup. The two parents therefore always differ in size, and their relation in Table 3 follows from their hypervolumes: if the smaller parent has no lower hypervolume, it Pareto-dominates the larger one; otherwise the larger one lexicographically dominates it. When one side has no suite, the parents come from the other side alone; in that edge case the call must compress or expand the suite toward the target while raising its hypervolume. The pool is global rather than niche-local for a structural reason: the acquisition frequently selects a niche no suite has reached yet, and a draw restricted to that niche’s own front would leave exactly those targets unbreedable. The w/o nearest-parents ablation replaces the ranking with a uniform draw over the same pool and changes nothing else — the candidates are still front members, so nothing dominated is ever shown, and the ordering rule below still applies.

paragraphs.en: The two parents and the target are arranged ascending under the order of Definition 1 — by hypervolume first, and by smaller size only when hypervolumes are equal — with the target always last, immediately before the continuation, where recency weighs the nearest example most [ 70 , 33 , 60 ] . paragraphs.en: With the two parents chosen and ordered ( Appendix C ), three further decisions turn them into a prompt: which of the two breeding framings the call is given, what execution signal is written into the module source, and how much of each piece is shown.

paragraphs.en: The module source shown in a breeding prompt is annotated with what the strongest parent still misses, written at the end of the exact line it describes rather than as a separate list of line numbers: # <-- NOT COVERED YET on a line none of its passing tests execute, and # <-- SURVIVING MUTANT: <op> on a line where that mutation survives its assertions. paragraphs.en: A general-purpose agent becomes useful in a vertical domain through knowledge its weights do not hold, and with frozen weights ( Section 2 ) it evolves by how that knowledge is streamed in, managed and retrieved. Streaming turns raw domain input, arriving continuously, into a structured form an agent can consume: knowledge graphs constructed from unstructured threat reports [ 10 ] , hybrid system logs parsed by a user-adaptive parser [ 59 ] , and natural language translated into first-order logic that symbolic reasoners can consume [ 46 ] . Management organizes and revises what has been accumulated: cyber threat intelligence (CTI) corpora organized into agent-native scaffolds that agents consume directly [ 13 ] , documentation optimized as repository-specific playbooks for coding agents [ 12 ] , and behavioral specifications of program entities refined recursively from the failures of the code generated from them [ 11 ] , where a local improvement must be kept from causing a regression elsewhere. Retrieval decides what of it reaches the agent at decision time, as benchmarked for retrieval-augmented LLMs over heterogeneous CTI sources [ 14 ] . Across the three stages, what lets a vertical agent evolve rather than drift is a signal, grounded in its domain, that decides which revisions of its knowledge to keep: knowledge graphs, corpora and parsers are typically judged once, by extraction or answer accuracy, and specifications and documentation by tests taken as given. This paper turns to that signal itself. In software, where it is executable, we search for the test suite that serves as it, strong enough to catch a revision that silently changes behavior and small enough to run on every revision, whether what is revised is documentation, a specification or, as in Section 5.3 , the agent’s own harness.
paragraphs.zh: 通用智能体通过掌握其权重所不包含的知识，在特定垂直领域变得有用；在权重被冻结的情况下（第 2 节），它会根据这些知识如何被输入、管理和检索而不断演化。 流式处理将持续到达的原始领域输入转化为智能体可使用的结构化形式：例如从非结构化威胁报告中构建的知识图谱 [10]、由用户自适应解析器解析的混合系统日志 [59]，以及被翻译成符号推理器可处理的谓词逻辑的自然语言 [46]。 管理环节负责组织和修订已积累的内容：将网络威胁情报（CTI）语料库整理为智能体可直接使用的原生框架 [13]；为编码智能体优化为特定存储库的剧本式文档 [12]；以及从基于这些文档生成的代码所出现的故障中递归地完善程序实体的行为规范 [11]，同时确保局部改进不会导致其他部分的性能倒退。 检索环节决定在决策时刻哪些内容会被传递给智能体，其效果可通过在异构 CTI 源上对检索增强型大语言模型进行基准测试来评估 [14]。 在这三个阶段中，使垂直领域智能体能够演化而非偏离正轨的关键，是一种基于其领域的信号，用于决定保留哪些知识修订：知识图谱、语料库和解析器通常仅通过提取或回答准确率进行一次评估，而行为规范和文档则通过既定测试进行评估。 本文将聚焦于这一信号本身。 在软件领域，由于该信号具有可执行性，我们寻找能够充当这一信号的测试套件：它必须足够强大以检测出那些悄无声息改变行为的修订，同时足够轻量以适用于每一次修订，无论被修订的内容是文档、行为规范，还是如第 5.3 节所述，智能体自身的运行框架。

sents.en: Streaming turns raw domain input, arriving continuously, into a structured form an agent can consume: knowledge graphs constructed from unstructured threat reports [ 10 ] , hybrid system logs parsed by a user-adaptive parser [ 59 ] , and natural language translated into first-order logic that symbolic reasoners can consume [ 46 ] .
sents.zh: 流式处理将持续到达的原始领域输入转化为智能体可使用的结构化形式：例如从非结构化威胁报告中构建的知识图谱 [10]、由用户自适应解析器解析的混合系统日志 [59]，以及被翻译成符号推理器可处理的谓词逻辑的自然语言 [46]。

sents.en: Management organizes and revises what has been accumulated: cyber threat intelligence (CTI) corpora organized into agent-native scaffolds that agents consume directly [ 13 ] , documentation optimized as repository-specific playbooks for coding agents [ 12 ] , and behavioral specifications of program entities refined recursively from the failures of the code generated from them [ 11 ] , where a local improvement must be kept from causing a regression elsewhere.
sents.zh: 管理环节负责组织和修订已积累的内容：将网络威胁情报（CTI）语料库整理为智能体可直接使用的原生框架 [13]；为编码智能体优化为特定存储库的剧本式文档 [12]；以及从基于这些文档生成的代码所出现的故障中递归地完善程序实体的行为规范 [11]，同时确保局部改进不会导致其他部分的性能倒退。

sents.en: Retrieval decides what of it reaches the agent at decision time, as benchmarked for retrieval-augmented LLMs over heterogeneous CTI sources [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: 检索环节决定在决策时刻哪些内容会被传递给智能体，其效果可通过在异构 CTI 源上对检索增强型大语言模型进行基准测试来评估 [14]。

sents.en: Across the three stages, what lets a vertical agent evolve rather than drift is a signal, grounded in its domain, that decides which revisions of its knowledge to keep: knowledge graphs, corpora and parsers are typically judged once, by extraction or answer accuracy, and specifications and documentation by tests taken as given.
sents.zh: 在这三个阶段中，使垂直领域智能体能够演化而非偏离正轨的关键，是一种基于其领域的信号，用于决定保留哪些知识修订：知识图谱、语料库和解析器通常仅通过提取或回答准确率进行一次评估，而行为规范和文档则通过既定测试进行评估。

sents.en: This paper turns to that signal itself.
sents.zh: 本文将聚焦于这一信号本身。

sents.en: In software, where it is executable, we search for the test suite that serves as it, strong enough to catch a revision that silently changes behavior and small enough to run on every revision, whether what is revised is documentation, a specification or, as in Section 5.3 , the agent’s own harness.
sents.zh: 在软件领域，由于该信号具有可执行性，我们寻找能够充当这一信号的测试套件：它必须足够强大以检测出那些悄无声息改变行为的修订，同时足够轻量以适用于每一次修订，无论被修订的内容是文档、行为规范，还是如第 5.3 节所述，智能体自身的运行框架。
